spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The artificer casts one of the following spells, using its Tinker's Tools as an Arcane Focus and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The artificer makes two attacks, using Battering Mace or Artillery Strike in any combination.

action.name: Battering Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
